sources.note: No prose statement. Primary data with acute accent marked on most forms: majority penultimate (bayápun 'afternoon', búris 'ashes', bálay 'house', kapúniʔ 'yesterday', lakúnaw 'big') but many final (akó 'I', kamí 'we', duwáy 'two', isdáʔ 'fish', daʔətə́n 'bad/ugly', budáŋ 'child', atáy 'here', istá 'there'); i.e. the transcription implies accent position is not fixed, but Zorc states no rule.
